items:
**FREE GOLF CART for February Stays!
~monthly snowbird rate options~

Unwind and rejuvenate in this newly renovated, upscale retreat on the south side of 30A!

Catching N Relax is a beautifully updated 4-bedroom + bunk room, 3-bath home located in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach, Santa Rosa Beach — just minutes from the sand, restaurants, and shops.

Step inside to an open-concept main level featuring a bright living area, modern furnishings, and brand-new flooring throughout. The fully equipped kitchen, dining area, and laundry are conveniently located on the first floor, along with a queen bedroom and full bath — perfect for guests who prefer main-level living.

Upstairs, the primary master suite offers a king bed, dedicated workspace/desk, and a luxurious ensuite bathroom with a walk-in shower. This suite also connects to a separate bunk room with a new bunk bed set, ideal for little ones. A second master suite features another king bed, full bath, and walk-in closet. The fourth bedroom includes two twin beds and a PS4 gaming system for endless fun.

Each bedroom is equipped with a flat-screen Smart TV (six TVs total) so everyone can unwind with their favorite shows after a day at the beach or pool.

Amenities include: bikes (4), beach toys, kayaks (2), paddle board, bike trailer for child, outdoor connect four and corn-hole, community pool and fitness center. Take your pick of several beach access points including a .3 mile walk to neighborhood access.
*6 seat golf cart optional add on with separate deposit, rental agreement and fee

You will find plenty of indoor entertainment between the 6 flat screen smart TVs, PS4, board games, books and wifi. The kitchen is stocked and includes a blender, Cuisinart toaster and coffee maker and stainless steel refrigerator and dishwasher. The bar features four comfortable, swivel bar stools. A beverage refrigerator is located in the dining area.

Outside you will find a porch swing, gas grill, fire patio table, outdoor shower and privacy fence.

Parking: 2-3 vehicles

~Location and Area Attractions ~
Catch N Relax is located in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach and is minutes to beaches, restaurants and shops. Take a short golf cart ride to Grayton, Watercolor or Seaside and explore each town and it's unique offerings. The World's Luckiest Fishing Village in Destin is also just a short drive away!

Community Pool, Fitness Center, Bocce/Putting Green/Shuffleboard: .4 miles

The doorbell camera is pointed to the driveway/exterior front of the home and is used to monitor the safety of the home and property.   Video and audio is recorded for safety and security purposes.

description:
Located near the beach, this vacation home is in Blue Mountain Beach, a neighborhood in Santa Rosa Beach. While the natural beauty of Grayton Beach State Park and Blue Mountain Beach can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Sundog Books and Eden Gardens State Park are also worth visiting. Jet skiing, kayaking, and scuba diving offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with cycling nearby.
